title: Hailuo AI Pricing 2026: Plans, Free Credits, Costs
summary: Hailuo AI pricing spans four tiers from Free to Master, so you can compare costs and features to find the right plan for your needs.
body_markdown:
## What a credit buys on Hailuo AI


Spend a credit and you get one slice of a generation, and the slice grows with the model, the resolution, the clip length and the mode. A clip's price is therefore its credit count times $0.0105 per credit.


That rate's what turns Hailuo's listed credit costs into dollars, and every retry pays it again, whether or not you keep the clip.


### Hailuo AI credits per clip by model


Pick the model (Hailuo 02 Standard, 02 Pro, 2.3), the resolution (512p, 768p, 1080p) and the length (6 or 10 seconds), and the price follows, so you'll see the cost only after specifying all three parameters.


Switch mode and the price moves again: text-to-video, image-to-video and subject reference each carry their own listed cost.


I'm not quoting the credit figures here, so take them from MiniMax's own Hailuo pricing page and apply the same arithmetic to each row you plan to use.


Multiply the listed credits by $0.0105 to get the dollar cost of one attempt, so you know your costs upfront.


Then divide that by the share of attempts you keep: if you keep one in three, the real cost of a usable clip is three times the listed one.


So **a 1080p Pro clip is the wrong default** for exploring a prompt. Draft at the cheapest listed tier, then pay for the expensive render only once the motion is right.


### Free tier limits and daily credits


Don't plan to produce on the free tier; it is built for testing. Daily free credits let you judge whether a prompt style works, but the free output carries a watermark and the limits cap what you can generate.


Spend a few days of free credits measuring how many attempts a usable clip takes for your kind of footage. That number decides which paid plan fits, because a high retry rate makes a bigger credit pool worth more than a lower sticker price.


### Hailuo AI credit expiry and rollover


Check on the pricing page whether a plan's credits roll over or expire at the end of the billing period. Check also whether daily free credits stack on top of purchased ones.


Expiring credits raise your cost per clip in a quiet month, since you paid for a pool you didn't use. Rolling credits don't.


If your output is uneven, a plan whose credits carry forward can beat a cheaper one that resets, even when its monthly price looks higher.
